::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru (Whitefield) startup founded 2024 building secure surveillance-camera SoCs. MPW tape-out in October 2025 under Cadence's Project VASU partnership; first commercial chip tape-out (UMC 28nm) announced May 2026. Raised $6M seed (Vertex Ventures, May 2026).
:::

## What does this firm design?

Secure IP-camera and surveillance SoCs with on-chip edge AI.
